cause: Competing publisher, stale command, software crash, or mode error
trigger: Unexpected nonzero command or motion outside an authorized state
mitigation: Single command owner, watchdog, Manual Safety Stop, Emergency Stop, state interlocks

cause: Incorrect footprint, inflation, controller tuning, or world geometry
trigger: Clearance below 0.20 m or any contact
mitigation: Validate footprint and geometry; conservative speeds; collision and clearance monitors

cause: Poor initial pose, symmetric features, bad TF, stale scan, or odometry drift
trigger: Covariance or pose freshness outside limits; implausible jump
mitigation: Readiness gate, asymmetric world, health monitoring, motion inhibition

cause: LiDAR or bridge failure, QoS mismatch, timing slowdown
effect: Robot drives using obsolete free space
trigger: Data age above 0.25 s or missed rate budget
mitigation: Freshness monitor, stop on loss, fault injection

cause: SLAM drift, bad odometry, incomplete coverage, or wrong resolution
effect: Blocked routes, false openings, poor localization
trigger: Map accuracy or topology test fails
mitigation: Map QA metrics, visual overlay, clean-restart test

risk: Temporary obstacle not marked or cleared
effect: Collision, needless blockage, or failed recovery
trigger: Marking or clearing latency exceeds target
mitigation: Dedicated TB tests; retain scan and costmap evidence

cause: Excess rendering, sensors, logging, or CPU/GPU load
effect: Stale data, delayed control, invalid trials
mitigation: Lightweight world, benchmarked launcher, performance logging

trigger: Temperature trend and clock/utilization evidence indicate throttling
mitigation: Monitor temperatures, reduce rendering load, stop invalid runs

cause: Provisional Create 3 values differ from final ASU robot
effect: Poor simulation behavior and sim-to-real mismatch
mitigation: Step 3 interface record; parameterize footprint, wheels, limits, and frames

cause: Isaac Sim, ROS 2, Nav2, bridge, or driver mismatch
mitigation: Freeze versions and installation procedure; clean-start smoke test

cause: Ad hoc goals, configuration drift, missing logs, or manual fixes
effect: Results cannot support portfolio or release claims
trigger: Trial lacks configuration identity or evidence
mitigation: Named scenarios, automatic metadata, immutable failure retention

cause: Unbounded behavior tree, backup, or repeated spin
effect: Collision risk, timeout, or confusing behavior
trigger: Recovery exceeds 30 s or repeats prohibited action
mitigation: Bounded recovery, no backup/repeated spin, failure to Ready

risk: Emergency Stop misunderstood as certified safety
cause: Simulation control is presented as physical protection
trigger: Documentation or demo makes physical-safety claim
mitigation: Explicit V1 limitation; separate V2 hardware gate

trigger: Documentation expands without enabling a decision, test, or reproduction
mitigation: One controlled baseline, generated CSVs, test details written during implementation

trigger: Another user cannot execute smoke test
mitigation: Lean operator instructions and release reproducibility test
